target.title: fix(discord): prevent stale gateway error listeners after restart
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where restarting or cleaning up the Discord gateway supervisor could remove the last `error` listener from the shared gateway emitter. If Discord emitted a late gateway `error` after the old supervisor was disposed, Node could treat it as an uncaught EventEmitter error and crash the gateway process.

## Why This Change Was Made

The supervisor now removes the disposed instance listener but leaves a single shared late-error guard on the gateway emitter when no other `error` listener remains. Starting a new supervisor removes that guard before installing the active lifecycle listener, so repeated restart/cleanup loops do not retain old supervisor closures or grow listener count.

This stays scoped to Discord gateway supervisor teardown; it does not change Discord config, schema, command behavior, or gateway lifecycle timing.

## User Impact

Discord channel restarts and startup-cleanup failures are safer: late gateway errors after cleanup are suppressed instead of crashing the process, while repeated supervisor restarts keep the gateway `error` listener count bounded.

## Evidence

- Runtime restart/cleanup proof using the production Discord gateway supervisor and a real Node EventEmitter:

  ```text
  [cycle 1] active event type=fatal
  [cycle 1] listenersAfterCreate=1 listenersAfterDispose=1 lateErrorThrew=false
  [cycle 2] active event type=fatal
  [cycle 2] listenersAfterCreate=1 listenersAfterDispose=1 lateErrorThrew=false
  [cycle 3] active event type=fatal
  [cycle 3] listenersAfterCreate=1 listenersAfterDispose=1 lateErrorThrew=false
  [summary] finalErrorListeners=1
  ```

- Focused validations:
  - `pnpm test extensions/discord/src/monitor/gateway-supervisor.test.ts` — 5 passed
  - `pnpm test extensions/discord/src/monitor/provider.test.ts` — 38 passed
  - `pnpm test extensions/discord/src/monitor.gateway.test.ts` — 7 passed
  - `pnpm test extensions/discord/src/monitor/provider.lifecycle.test.ts` — 22 passed
